name: Joseph Wenz

events.title: Godfather to Friedrich (Frederick) Meier
events.description: 'Joseph Wenz, Schuster von hier' was godfather at the baptism of Maria Anna Birkenmaier's son Friedrich.

events.title: Wife godmother to Christina Mayer
events.description: His wife M. Anna Mayer, 'Ehefrau des Joseph Wenz, Bürger und Schuster von hier', was godmother.

bioAdditions: Joseph Wenz, a shoemaker and citizen of Munzingen, was married to Friedrich Mayer's eldest sister Maria Anna Creszentia. He was godfather to Friedrich's first son in January 1862 (S1), and his wife was godmother to Pauline Mayer's daughter Christina in 1864 (S2).
